LanguageData.WFL_FW_CountsLine: {0} House members · {1} household residents in {2} households
LanguageData.WFL_FW_CountsTip: Family is kinship by blood, adoption or choice. The House is who belongs to it, leads it and carries its name and standing. A household is the people who share a home. They overlap but are not the same: a spouse can live in this home and still belong to another House.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_CountsOthers: {0} of the people living in its households belong to other Houses.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_CountsElsewhere: {0} House members live in other households or away.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_ChapterTip: What the family is mostly living through right now, put together from what the records show. It is a summary of real events and situations, never an invention.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NoOtherThreads: No other situation is shaping the family's days.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_ThreadActionsAny: What the family's members can do:
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Ch_Unknown: What this House is going through is unknown to {0}. Only what {0} took part in is shown.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Ch_Quiet: House {0} is enjoying a quiet period. Nothing is pressing, and the household goes about its days.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_NoHead: The House can choose a head, or succession will settle it.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_NoSteward: A steward can keep the House's stores and duties in order.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_FoodLow: Household members may seek aid, trade or additional food.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_HousingProblem: Beds, rooms or a new household could ease it.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_SafetyLow: Defence, allies or a safer home would help.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_CapabilityGap: Teaching a relative, or welcoming someone skilled, could fill it.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_PromiseDue: Whoever made the promise can keep it, or explain.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_OpenRift: Time together, an apology or aid may begin to mend it.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_Grievance: Aid, restitution or an apology can settle what is owed.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_CeremonyPrep: Invitations, a place and a time can be arranged.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_Petition: The House head can hear them.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertHint_Negotiation: Those involved can talk it through, support it or oppose it.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Act_KeepPromise: Keep the promise, or explain why not
